data.one_liner: Provides a typewriter text animation widget driven by a stream.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a StatefulWidget that animates text like a typewriter, updating as new data arrives from a Stream. It supports maxLines, overflow handling, and optional haptic feedback during animation.
use_when: You need a typewriter effect for text that updates in real‑time via a Stream
You want built‑in haptic feedback while the text animates
You prefer a ready‑made widget without writing custom animation code
avoid_when: The text is static and does not require streaming
You need extensive styling or custom animation beyond the provided options
Performance is critical for very large bodies of text
strengths: Easy to drop‑in with just an import
weaknesses: Limited customization compared to building your own animation
Only works with streams, not plain strings
Relies on animated_text_kit, adding an extra dependency
